scope: Exploratory follow-up to 76 identical-profile unresolved requests; a disposable probe preceded this freeze and is not confirmatory evidence
comparison_contract: Same observations, declared positive-spectrum class, targets, margins and progressive nominal node budgets. Completed methods add one finite target-aware witness atom, never impose a rate cap. Uniform interval uses four LPs per level. Tail-completed interval uses two outer interval LPs plus two completed finite-node LPs; continuous dual uses two completed finite-node LPs and whole-halfline residual checking. Count residual cells separately from LP variables; no wall-clock speed claim.
go_criteria: Report every sufficient/insufficient/unresolved outcome including lost resolved decisions and opposite decisive labels
Audit all finite physical primal witnesses and continuous dual residual bounds including the infinite tail
Check every returned positive joint prediction at nominal and endpoint input scalings
Retain all non-applicable unequal-profile requests unchanged when reporting the 5256-request parent portfolio
Report the tail-completion ablation separately: closing numerical indecision is not a new information theorem
limitations: Same four synthetic generating spectra and 12 observation sets; added times and loading profiles are not independent external material validation
Accelerator restricted to identical positive loading profiles gamma=beta; other targets retain the preceding method
Very fast physical witness atoms can have enormous but finite original mass, allowed only in the explicitly uncapped model
The residual bound and physical repair are analytically justified; floating-point implementation is not outward-rounded certification
Weak duality, interval derivative bounds and exchange-like finite supports are classical tools; no claim of a new general optimization algorithm
This is post-diagnostic exploratory evidence, not a prospectively independent replication or guaranteed journal acceptance
